# Monday of the week, in UTC, as a date string

> [`mondayOf`](weekly-seller-payouts.md) takes a date and returns the Monday that starts its ISO week, computed in UTC, as a `YYYY-MM-DD` string used as the payout's week key.

_Part of [Payout journals in the ledger](ledger-posting-model.md)_

[`mondayOf`](weekly-seller-payouts.md) is a small exported helper at the bottom of `payout.jobs.ts`. It answers one question: which Monday does this date's week start on? The answer is always in UTC, never in the server's local time zone. It works in three steps. First it rebuilds the date at midnight UTC, so the time of day is dropped. Then it steps back by the number of days since Monday (the `(getUTCDay() + 6) % 7` trick turns Sunday-first day numbers into Monday-first ones, so Monday is 0 and Sunday is 6). Last it formats the result with `toISOString().slice(0, 10)` to get `YYYY-MM-DD`. The weekly job `payouts.run-weekly` uses it when it runs. If the job payload has no `periodStart`, it calls `mondayOf(new Date())` to pick the current week. That string is saved as the payout's `periodStart`. Together with the shop, it forms the unique key that stops a second payout for the same shop and week. See [Weekly seller payouts](weekly-seller-payouts.md) and [Period start: the Monday date that identifies the payout week](period-start-weekly-identifier.md).

**Look at:** [`mondayOf` in payout.jobs.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/infra/payout.jobs.ts#L51) · [payout.jobs.ts](../../../../packages/backend/libs/domains/payments/infra/payout.jobs.ts)

## What it touches

| Kind | Name | How |
|---|---|---|
| database | `Payout.periodStart` | The string from [`mondayOf`](weekly-seller-payouts.md) is written here on insert. With the shop id it makes the one-payout-per-shop-per-week key. |

## Also relies on

- [Weekly seller payouts](weekly-seller-payouts.md): The `payouts.run-weekly` job calls it to pick the week key when no `periodStart` is given.

## Watch out

- It uses UTC, but the cron schedule is set in the `Europe/Warsaw` time zone (`0 6 * * 1`). Early Monday in Warsaw is still Monday in UTC, so the two agree at 06:00 local, but the helper never uses local time.
- The time of day is dropped. Any moment on a given UTC day maps to the same Monday.
- A caller can pass `periodStart` in the job payload. In that case [`mondayOf`](weekly-seller-payouts.md) is skipped, and the value is used as given with no check that it is a Monday.
